text: I needed to ask Samejima about the old woman.
Yes, I would ask him, and he would confirm what I already knew. And that’s when I would tell him I had to quit soon, for my health.

name: Samejima
text: I knew you’d be back, lucky cat.
Behind the booth stood Samejima, lazily twirling his hands.

name: Maneki
text: Can I ask you some--

name: Samejima
text: By the way, since you’re such a devoted patron, you now have access to the VIP menu.

name: Samejima
text: Be sure to check the tablet. You’ll see extra drinks that will be of use.

name: Maneki
text: Oh– really?

name: Samejima
text: Now, how can I help you?
Ask him about the old woman.

name: Maneki
text: A-actually, it's nothing. I’ll check out the menu straight-away!

name: Maneki
text: I think you’re right that Waterfall was her secret strategy.
Samejima had no way to confirm.
Paws trembling, I set the voucher on the counter. The man regarded it like a squid on a plate.

name: Samejima
text: Gehehe, well done. For those who know how to harness it, passion yields many rewards.
Samejima seized the voucher between his teeth and disappeared into the booth.
Soon, he returned with a bundle of yen. The smooth bills filled the void between my paws.

name: Samejima
text: Enjoy yourself, now.

name: Maneki
text: Thank you...
I knew I would go back to the parlor as soon as I left his gaze.

name: Maneki
text: Just a little bit more...
SOMETIME IN THE NIGHT.
